candidate_policy: all possible families up to maximum indegree
transform: sinh(1.25 * asinh(x) + 0.5) on each continuous column; discrete columns unchanged
pairing: same graph, coefficients, discrete observations and base random draws; smaller n is a row prefix of the n=5000 sample
reference: exact order posterior for SMC error; positive log-space exact structure posterior to expose ordering-prior effects
interpretation: Fixed settings, no tuning. Recovery is reported even when poor. Exact-posterior deterioration implicates the score/prior/model, not automatically the sampler. Non-Gaussian transformation deliberately tests misspecification; it is not a claim of a matched likelihood. CLG is assessed separately in the completed corrected V3 cohort.
